title: Research: lower selected complex scalar primitives by 22–25% (no new kappa)
body:
The selected CK and JP8 complex programs price every dyadic addition with cleared-work binary Horner. This research contribution replaces its leading clear/add pair with a copy and uses signed accumulation plus a work clear for unit coefficients. Both circuits preserve arbitrary private input and the complete scalar boundary.

**Status: finite complex-supplier circuit improvement / research note; no new κ.**

| Provider | Orientation | Original real primitives | Replacement | Saved |
| --- | --- | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| CK | Forward | 224,938 | 169,618 | 55,320 |
| CK | Backward | 224,986 | 169,634 | 55,352 |
| JP8 | Forward | 257,232 | 200,380 | 56,852 |
| JP8 | Backward | 257,280 | 200,396 | 56,884 |

The 22.1–24.6% reduction covers scalar primitives, including source copies, coefficient preparation, signed accumulation and private clearing. Recursive calls, adapters and residual wrappers retain their existing costs. Scalar macro words, frames, paid profiles and κ are unchanged. No runtime speedup is claimed.

Only `research/complex-dyadic-lowering/` is added. It contains the executable lowering, exact rational primitive interpreter, deterministic certificate, source pins, proof, local sprint claim and validation receipt. No selected emitter or certificate is changed.

### Reproduce

```sh
python3 -B research/complex-dyadic-lowering/verify.py
```

Expected:

```text
PASS_COMPLEX_DYADIC_LOWERING programs=4 columns=716 savings=55320,55352,56852,56884 controls=10
```

Python 3.11+, standard library, offline, no writes. Both receipt modes check the committed evidence. The verifier executes all 716 input columns of each selected program plus an arbitrary coefficient-work input. It checks all 686 distinct coefficients and proves finite prefix containment by exact per-register row membership in the reference Horner traces. Ten controls cover wrong signs, omitted copy/cleanup, coefficient and alias errors, cost inflation, and endpoint-neutral prefix growth.

### Validation and scope

- Exact base: `66849e1475c930fd7732b1a0067ffee7e1e95f60`; assignment seed **22**, complex supplier track.
- Selected PR626 source: `660de893d27bb7abd1d5b01b1640207528a5c851`, with the retained PR622 construction and #543 bit supplier. Consumed sources use exact or decompressed-payload SHA256 pins.
- Focused replay passes on Python 3.14.8 and Python 3.11.15 with `-O`. `make selected-record-check` passes. Additional scoped AI review found no remaining blocking issue.
- Final overlap check covered 513 open PRs through #693. Related historical #411 is credited for coefficient microcircuits. #681 changes a factory scalar word; this lowers unchanged selected macros and does not depend on #681.
- No pinned coordination issue exists, so the claim is recorded locally. The package includes attribution to the supplier lineage and disclosure of substantial OpenAI Codex assistance.

Repository-wide `make verify`, cold supplier regeneration, Linux CI and Lean were not run. The unchanged geometric/physical admission and uniform precision, compiler, hosting, tape and analytic contracts remain inherited. This is an exact local circuit result, not a formal proof of the multiplication theorem or production integration of a new selected supplier.
